description: This file implements the ConnectJob class and related parameters for managing network socket connection attempts, including connection timing, timeout handling, and delegate notifications within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: CommonConnectJobParams
classes.description: Holds parameters shared across connection jobs, such as socket factory, resolver, and security context.

classes.name: ConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing a network connection, including timing, timeout, and delegate notification.

methods.name: ConnectJob::Connect
methods.description: Initiates the connection process, starts timeout timer, and logs the start event.

methods.name: ConnectJob::PassSocket
methods.description: Returns ownership of the established socket.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of the connection attempt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::SetSocket
methods.description: Sets the socket object and associated DNS aliases.

methods.name: ConnectJob::NotifyDelegateOfCompletion
methods.description: Notifies the delegate that the connection attempt has completed with a result code.

methods.name: ConnectJob::OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles connection timeout, cancels socket, logs timeout, and notifies delegate.
